status: Planned; no behavioral case executed in this documentation step

cases.title: Existing provider source compatibility
cases.procedure: Compile actual implementers with existing required members, defaults and caller code against the exact candidate; compare overload resolution and nullable/compiler diagnostics.
cases.requiredEvidence: Default members stay optional; no new required implementation or accidental overload ambiguity.

cases.title: Unchanged consumer binaries
cases.procedure: Use retained old consumer binaries and exact candidate dependency replacements; exercise methods, interface dispatch, boxing, collections and generic/container values on supported runtimes.
cases.requiredEvidence: No unsupported slot, missing member, load or value corruption; original builds and package identities retained.

cases.title: Enum and optional argument constants
cases.procedure: Compare every captured enum constant/default, especially XML 0/1/2/4/8/16/32/64/127; run old compiled call sites whose defaults were embedded.
cases.requiredEvidence: No numeric remapping or silent default-behavior change; XML storage mappings preserved.

cases.title: Managed value layout and carriers
cases.procedure: Compare type/field shape and supported-runtime managed size/layout; pass old/new XdmValue and XdmSequence through boxing, arrays, callbacks and unchanged binaries.
cases.requiredEvidence: Metadata alone is insufficient; typed/reference slots and observable accessor behavior remain valid.

cases.title: Node identity and order
cases.procedure: Use repeated axes, aliases, wrappers in both directions, roots/snapshots/generations and mixed providers; evaluate identity/hash/order/deduplication.
cases.requiredEvidence: Preserve snapshot-relative identity, symmetric wrapper behavior and declared ordering without conflating schema component identity.

cases.title: Typed values and atomization
cases.procedure: Exercise atomic/list/union/empty/no-typed-value cases, argument/results, casts and numeric conversions with original type identities.
cases.requiredEvidence: Retain original authority and list/union values; FOTY0012 where specified; plain XML behavior stays qualified separately.

cases.title: Lazy ownership and early termination
cases.procedure: Enumerate zero/one/all items, abandon results, throw/cancel between fetches, dispose input before/during enumeration and reopen an independently owned fixture.
cases.requiredEvidence: Explicit owner releases leases at agreed boundaries; no accidental caller disposal, revived snapshots or unproved automatic cleanup.

cases.title: Nested and escaped values
cases.procedure: Retain nodes in maps/arrays/functions/external values and deferred sequences; copy/box/pass results beyond evaluation scope and dispose the caller owner.
cases.requiredEvidence: References retain agreed metadata authority without extending disposed input validity; nested ownership is explicit.

cases.title: Single-pass sequencing
cases.procedure: Use an actual marked producer, attempted second enumeration, early exit, throwing fetch and document-order/duplicate assertions.
cases.requiredEvidence: Marker guarantees are preserved; no hidden materialization or invented repeatability/disposal guarantee.

cases.title: Compile/evaluate environment and caches
cases.procedure: Vary language/profile, schema closure, effective URIs, namespace/options and authority individually; test concurrent independent contexts and post-compile mutable inputs.
cases.requiredEvidence: Accepted semantic capture/cache identity prevents stale reuse; legacy setters do not imply thread safety.

cases.title: Resource authority and cancellation
cases.procedure: Exercise denied/imported/missing resources, resolver/provider faults, cancellation and reentry on owned fixtures with exact resource receipts.
cases.requiredEvidence: Preserve resource policy and original failure/cancellation; no hidden fallback or authority escalation.

cases.title: Assessment preserve/strip/copy
cases.procedure: Exercise existing bounded bridge plus agreed general provider on copies, descendants/attributes, edited content and escaped trees.
cases.requiredEvidence: Original provenance/PSVI retained on preserve, removed on strip; stale assessment refused; bounded success does not certify full support.

cases.title: Component universe and compatible views
cases.procedure: Use same QName/different closures, imports/redefine/override/chameleon cases, anonymous types and distinct compatible sessions after contract acceptance.
cases.requiredEvidence: No QName/root-digest authority shortcut; compatibility proof and original PSVI are explicit.

cases.title: Ordinary untyped persistent XML
cases.procedure: Execute complete provider/differential tests and reopen existing supported stores using freshly owned fixtures; compare query behavior and format bytes.
cases.requiredEvidence: No required schema/JSON storage or migration; XML enums, histories and CanReclaim=false unchanged.

cases.title: Errors and refusals
cases.procedure: Record baseline and candidate error identities for invalid, unsupported, absent-provider and provider-fault cases; distinguish legacy/BCL paths.
cases.requiredEvidence: No invented W3C errors or downgrade; preserve documented no-provider behavior and supported-profile refusal.

cases.title: Concurrency and disposal isolation
cases.procedure: Run supported independent sessions/snapshots, cancellation isolation and ownership schedules; enumerate excluded concurrent-disposal/reentry scenarios.
cases.requiredEvidence: Shared immutable metadata does not certify mutable snapshot/context concurrency; no stronger claim than executed evidence.

cases.title: Package and assembly identity
cases.procedure: Build package-only consumers from exact artifacts; record source/package/archive/assembly identity, signing/provenance and transitive dependencies.
cases.requiredEvidence: Same qualified candidate for both consumers; no source-override-only or synthetic-only release claim.

cases.title: Full tests and frozen engine gates
cases.procedure: Run full solution tests plus QT3 and gated qt4, capturing exact retained skip names/reasons and comparing adopted baselines.
cases.requiredEvidence: QT3 31,397/0/424 and qt4 8,941/0/1,918 over 230 gated sets unchanged unless separately adopted.

cases.title: API manifest and scope drift
cases.procedure: Verify baseline hashes, one-to-one row coverage, exact overload IDs, classifications, closure and linked cases; review every proposed signature/default/enum/layout change.
cases.requiredEvidence: No omitted or duplicate metadata row, automatic freeze or silent excluded dependency.

cases.title: Mixed draft and established members
cases.procedure: Separate current-draft JNode/record/profile members from the proposed stable selection, inspect public signature reachability and execute any retained-profile compatibility cases.
cases.requiredEvidence: Exclusion is a proposed scope decision, not removal or waiver of existing compatibility; no forced JSON persistence.
